candidates.name: Fruit borer (Helicoverpa armigera)
candidates.economic_threshold: 1 larva or 5% damaged fruit per plant on 20-plant scout
candidates.monitoring: Pheromone traps (5/acre), weekly larval count on 20 plants
control_cultural: deep summer ploughing to expose pupae
timely sowing to avoid peak moth flight
control_biological: NPV (nuclear polyhedrosis virus) spray at early instar
control_chemical: label-approved emamectin benzoate or indoxacarb only past ET, rotate mode of action

candidates.name: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci)
candidates.economic_threshold: 8-10 adults per leaf (top 3 leaves), or visible leaf curl symptoms
candidates.monitoring: Yellow sticky traps (10-12/acre), leaf-turn count twice weekly
control_chemical: label-approved diafenthiuron or spiromesifen only past ET, never repeat same mode of action

candidates.name: Aphids (Aphis gossypii / Myzus persicae)
candidates.economic_threshold: 10-15 aphids per shoot tip on 20% plants
candidates.monitoring: Visual scouting of terminal shoots twice weekly
control_cultural: intercrop with coriander/dill to attract predators
control_biological: conserve ladybird beetle and lacewing populations
control_chemical: label-approved thiamethoxam or flonicamid only past ET, never on flowering crop during pollinator activity

candidates.name: Pink bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella)
candidates.economic_threshold: 8-10 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive nights, or 5% damaged bolls
candidates.monitoring: Pheromone traps (5/acre) from 45 days after sowing
control_biological: mating disruption pheromone dispensers in high-risk zones
control_chemical: label-approved profenofos rotation only past ET; resistance management mandatory (rotate MoA groups)

candidates.name: Thrips (Thrips palmi / Scirtothrips dorsalis)
candidates.monitoring: Blue sticky traps, leaf/flower shake count weekly
control_cultural: border crop of maize/sorghum as barrier
control_chemical: label-approved fipronil or spinosad only past ET, avoid during flowering

pest.disclaimer: Field-scouting judgment and state agricultural extension guidance take precedence. Chemical control listed last by IPM design — confirm current CIBRC label and pre-harvest interval before use.

schedule.note: Light frequent irrigation until roots establish

micronutrients: magnesium and boron for boll retention

fertilizer.disclaimer: Doses are general package-of-practices figures, not a soil-test-based recommendation. A soil test (especially for P and K, and micronutrients) should override these generic figures where available.

yield_estimate.disclaimer: Baseline is a national average, not this specific field's history. Actual yield depends heavily on variety, pest/disease pressure, and management not captured here — treat as a planning estimate, not a guarantee.

recommended_vegetative_measures.name: Vetiver grass hedgerows on contour
recommended_vegetative_measures.role: Slows runoff, traps sediment, stabilizes bund — deep roots, non-invasive

recommended_vegetative_measures.name: Cover cropping in off-season
recommended_vegetative_measures.role: Roots hold soil, reduces raindrop-impact erosion, adds organic matter

recommended_vegetative_measures.name: Strip cropping (alternating erosion-prone and soil-binding crops)
recommended_vegetative_measures.role: Breaks up long erosion-prone slope runs

recommended_vegetative_measures.name: Residue/organic mulching
recommended_vegetative_measures.role: Reduces raindrop impact and surface runoff velocity on any slope
